name: Mondrian Singapore Duxton
short_description: A 302-room 5-star lifestyle hotel on Duxton Hill near the CBD, with a rooftop pool and a 4.4/5 ALL rating from over 2,600 reviews.
ai_summary: Mondrian Singapore Duxton occupies Duxton Hill, a heritage shophouse district a short walk from Singapore's Central Business District. The hotel has 302 rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking either the historic shophouses or the modern skyline, a cinematic rooftop pool, and an eclectic mix of bars and restaurants. Accor's own listing shows a 4.4/5 ALL guest rating across roughly 2,653 reviews, placing guests at the centre of one of Singapore's most active dining and drinking strips.

faqs.question: How many rooms does Mondrian Singapore Duxton have?
faqs.answer: 302 rooms, each with floor-to-ceiling windows offering either heritage shophouse views over Duxton Hill or modern skyline views toward the Central Business District. The hotel sits on Duxton Hill, a short walk from Singapore's CBD, with a rooftop pool and a curated mix of bars and restaurants that put guests at the centre of one of the city's liveliest dining and drinking strips.
